fusions.name: Landslip
fusions.desc: Levers a boulder loose and sends it rolling. It deals 30 rock damage to the first enemy it meets, then bursts, hitting every enemy within 3 tiles for 80% of that.

fusions.name: Spall
fusions.desc: Strikes stone with the blade's edge, spraying chips in a cone 2.5 tiles long for 4 rock damage, with a 30% chance to leave each enemy [Sundered] for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Tumbling Cairn
fusions.desc: Piles a cairn that stands for 10 seconds and sheds rocks on an enemy within 4 tiles for 4 damage every second, each hit with a 30% chance to leave the target [Slowed] for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: Dug to Bedrock
fusions.desc: Your maximum health rises by 12, and your armour rises by 6%.
